title: Factor-size-16 three-factor beam-7/8 frontier
question: Can increasing the factor-size-16 three-factor beam beyond 6 recover the 0.90 capability floor while keeping the reranked state fraction below the robust two-factor reference?
hypothesis: At factor_size=16 and factor_count=3, increasing beam from 6 to 7 or 8 should raise product-cell admission enough to recover low-M capability; beam 8 has a geometric cell fraction of (8/16)^3=12.5%, still below the 0.1542864583 reference.

arms.name: three_factor_16_beam7
arms.intervention: three-factor product-key addressing with factor size 16 and beam 7

arms.name: three_factor_16_beam8
arms.intervention: three-factor product-key addressing with factor size 16 and beam 8

endpoints.name: target_recall_retention_ratio
endpoints.description: selective target recall divided by exhaustive target recall

decision_rule.condition: For every registered beam in {7,8} and M in {128,256,512}, report exact pooled exhaustive and selective target counts, retention, proposal retention, conditional selection given admission, states scored/M, absolute scored count, pair-generation operations, arithmetic, and occupancy.
decision_rule.licenses: a workload-specific factor-size-16 beam-frontier measurement beyond beam 6.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal beam optimality, semantic retrieval guarantees, asymptotic sublinear scaling, or hardware speedup.

decision_rule.condition: A beam is capability-eligible only when target_recall_retention_ratio is at least 0.90 at every registered M.
decision_rule.licenses: that the registered beam meets the capability floor on the tested workload.

decision_rule.condition: An eligible beam improves the registered robust two-factor reference only when mean states_scored_over_M across M={128,256,512} is strictly below 0.1542864583.
decision_rule.licenses: a workload-specific frontier improvement relative to the preregistered reference.
decision_rule.does_not_license: sublinear asymptotic scaling or universal architectural superiority.

held_constant: width-16 cosine teacher and training-only codebook fitting
48 fixed training codes versus 16 held-out target codes
protocol_note: Direct continuation of the measured factor-size-16 beam-4/5/6 experiment. Beams 7 and 8 are registered as a new experiment; no outcome from the prior measurement changes the verdict rule. The additional conditional_selection_given_admission endpoint decomposes post-admission reranking loss from coarse-cell admission loss.
